prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training day - high-endurance athlete needing 3000+ calories with carbohydrate loading and strategic recovery nutrition timing

solution_criteria: Meal plan totals 3000+ calories with emphasis on carbohydrates (55-65% of total calories)
Includes 4-5 meals/snacks strategically timed around training (pre-workout, during/post-workout, recovery)
Compact format presented as single-day schedule with times and portion sizes
All meals are practical, realistic, and support marathon endurance and recovery
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring 3000+ calories with emphasis on carbohydrate loading and recovery nutrition timing throughout the day

prompt_inputs.goal: Build muscle mass and strength with high protein intake for weightlifting

solution_criteria: Meal plan contains minimum 150g protein distributed across all meals
Includes pre- and post-workout nutrition timing around training session
Provides balanced micronutrients (iron, zinc, magnesium) supporting recovery
Compact format with 4-5 meals listed with approximate portions and macros
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength-focused athlete (weightlifter) needing high protein intake (150+ grams) with specific meal timing around training sessions and micronutrient balance

prompt_inputs.goal: High-performance basketball player needs sustained energy and muscle recovery for court play
prompt_inputs.restrictions: Vegan (no animal products including dairy, eggs, honey)

solution_criteria: All meals and snacks are completely plant-based with no animal products
Total daily calories and macronutrients support athletic performance (approximately 2,800-3,200 calories with adequate protein for muscle recovery)
Meal plan is compact and concise (4-5 meals/snacks maximum)
Includes practical, accessible vegan alternatives that support basketball performance
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport-specific dietary restriction scenario (vegan basketball player) requiring complete plant-based alternatives while meeting caloric and macro needs for court performance
